title: Surjection
summary: A surjective function reaches every element of its declared codomain.

context.note: This node belongs to one explicit foundational presentation; alternate foundations may encode it differently.

assumptions.text: The declared functions context is fixed.

content.plain: A surjective function reaches every element of its declared codomain.
content.exact: f:X→Y is surjective iff ∀y∈Y ∃x∈X with f(x)=y.
content.example: n↦n mod 2 maps integers onto the two parity classes.
content.caveat: Surjectivity changes if the codomain declaration changes.
